source.snippet: I wonder how much it would take in a monthly subscription to offset the money they make in ads? Picturing an Instagram without drivel... that I would pay for simply to escape for 15 minutes. Curate the good content... Time lock it based on my prefs so that it respects me as a human being, doesn't try to feed off of me. (2026-06-20)

problem_statement: Consumers want a paid, ad-free, non-manipulative social content feed with time-limiting and curation controls, but no mainstream product offers this — existing platforms monetize through addictive engagement patterns.
target_segment: Adult professionals and knowledge workers who use social media for leisure but are frustrated by addictive design, ads, and low-quality content.
notes: Single commenter explicitly states willingness to pay a monthly subscription. Weak signal strength due to single source, but buyer intent is clear and articulated. Hobbyist-adjacent but the willingness-to-pay framing and 'work-life' context elevate it slightly. Existing players: Artifact (defunct), Flipboard, Feedly. Gap: true time-lock + AI curation combo with social feel. Low-cost MVP possible as a curated newsletter or RSS reader with spend controls.
